entities.name: 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by the network after starting a common 5GMM procedure while waiting for a response from the UE.

entities.name: Common 5GMM procedure
entities.description: A 5GMM common procedure initiated by the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that initiates the common 5GMM procedure and enters the 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state.

entities.name: UE response
entities.description: Response expected from the UE after the network initiates a common 5GMM procedure.

relations.description: Initiating a common 5GMM procedure causes the network to enter the 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state.
The network initiates the common 5GMM procedure.
The 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state is maintained while waiting for a response from the UE.
